fieldValues.title: Affirmed clusters are the owner's; suggested clusters are the synthesiser's
fieldValues.decision_question: What may an agent do to clusters?
fieldValues.context: Stated by the owner on 2026-10-16 after affirming the Agent memory clusters, together with problem SP-73 (clusters cannot be compared side by side). Applies to the synthesiser standing job (clerk#39).
fieldValues.decision_statement: The synthesiser may add, merge, reshape and rename the clusters it suggested. An affirmed cluster belongs to the owner: no agent removes it or rewrites its name or description, but an agent may add problems to it.
fieldValues.rationale: The synthesiser does valid work and should keep refining its suggestions; a cluster's name is the claim the owner affirms, so it stays the owner's, while its membership is a working view that may grow.
fieldValues.revisit_when: Problems added by agents change what an affirmed cluster means, or an affirmed cluster needs a change only an agent has seen.
